    - paragraph
    - heading [level=3]
    - paragraph: "\"Amazon IVS has been instrumental in supporting our rapidly growing Easygo engineering team, by being able to scale to over 30M end users on our live-streaming product, with concurrent streams scaling to 1M with creators growing their community reliably, every day. The low-latency streaming and high-definition video ensure seamless interactions, crucial for live events. Emerging artists, gamers, and professional creators benefit from dynamic viewer engagement and collaborative features. Stability of Amazon IVS means the platform can run gaming events, live sports, and music concerts effortlessly. We highly recommend Amazon IVS for anyone looking to enhance their live streaming experiences.”"

Request bytes are limited to what Playwright exposes; not_exposed does not establish body absence or multipart file coverage.
Network content reads settle within 5 seconds each and the observer does not request bodies from unfinished responses.
Playwright scenario events do not expose request initiator stacks; receipt order does not prove causality.
Storage values are hashed only after declared-secret redaction.
